dct_creator_sm: Odynak, Dave; Krahn, Harvey; Gartrell, John; Kinzel, Cliff.
dct_description_sm: This study was designed to collect data comparable to previous studies on attitudes toward the mentally ill as well as new information pertaining to the formerly mentally ill. Many of the questions used in this survey came from the 1986 Winnipeg Area Survey.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available without information on how it can be used. You should communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
dct_title_s: Public Attitudes in Alberta Toward the Formerly Mentally Ill, 1990
